test_title: PYST 63: RRB Group D - GA (Held On: 24 Dec, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: The Web-Portal for the Prime Minister’s Awards for Excellence in Public Administration 2025 was officially launched on 1 October 2025 by which of the following?

options.text: Department of Administrative Reforms and Public Grievances
Centre for Development of Advanced Computing
Bureau of Police Research and Development

solution:
The correct answer is __**Department of Administrative Reforms and Public Grievances**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The web portal for the **Prime Minister’s Awards for Excellence in Public Administration 2025** was officially launched on **1 October 2025** by the **Department of Administrative Reforms and Public Grievances** (**DARPG**).
 
• The dedicated portal, **www.pmawards.gov.in**, was made operational to facilitate the **registration** and **submission** of applications from across the country in a **completely digital** and paperless manner.
 
• The primary objective of these awards is to recognize the **extraordinary** and **innovative work** performed by **Districts** as well as **Central and State Government Organizations** to ensure the welfare of citizens.
 
• For the **2025** cycle, the scheme has been redesigned to reflect the priorities of **Viksit Bharat**, focusing on **holistic development** and the **effective implementation** of priority programs.
 
• The launch marks the beginning of a multi-tier evaluation process where **Civil Servants** showcase their contributions toward **nation-building** and **governance reforms**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Department of Administrative Reforms and Public Grievances (DARPG):**
 
 
• It is the nodal agency for **administrative reforms** and **redressal of public grievances** under the **Ministry of Personnel, Public Grievances and Pensions**.
 
• The department is responsible for formulating **policy guidelines** for government agencies to improve **operational efficiency** and **citizen-centric governance**.
 
 
 
• **The PM’s Awards Scheme:**
 
 
• Instituted in the year **2006**, the scheme acknowledges the **exemplary performance** of **Civil Servants** in the implementation of **flagship programs**.
 
• The award consists of a **Trophy**, a **Citation**, and a **Cash Incentive** which is utilized for **institutional strengthening** or project replication in the winning districts.
 
 
 
• **Evaluation Process:**
 
 
• The selection involves a rigorous **three-tier process**: screening by an **Expert Committee**, evaluation by an **Empowered Committee**, and final approval by the **Prime Minister of India**.
 
• Parameters for evaluation include **citizen feedback**, **field visits**, and **outcome-based indicators**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Civil Services Day:** The awards are traditionally conferred every year on **21 April**, which is celebrated as **Civil Services Day** in India to commemorate the address of **Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel** to the first batch of probationers at **Metcalfe House** in **1947**.
 
• **Maximum Governance, Minimum Government:** This scheme is a pillar of the government's vision to promote **transparency**, **accountability**, and **technology-driven administration** across all **700+ districts** of India.
 
• **Incentivizing Excellence:** By highlighting success stories, the portal encourages the **replication of best practices** in different geographical and socio-economic terrains of the country.
